description: Execute a Redis command on a Redis connection. Use the db argument to select a logical database instead of sending SELECT. Use SCAN rather than KEYS when enumerating keys.

command.description: Redis command to execute, for example GET mykey or INFO

connection_id.description: Unique ID of the DBX connection

db.description: Redis logical database number. Use this argument instead of the SELECT command.

name: dbx_execute_redis_command
